course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Parameters, filters and grouping
goal: Distinguish dataset parameters, detail filters and aggregate conditions using discriminating input.

prerequisites.text: onec.p8; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: Filter level changes meaning
paragraphs: Filtering rows before aggregation differs from filtering groups after it. “Requests longer than 30 minutes” is not “customers totaling more than 30.” A customer with two short requests distinguishes them. Settings must express the intended requirement.

The previous source retains the own-customer filter and applies minutes>30 to detail:30/45 yields 45. Moving the condition to sum(minutes)>30 is different: the customer total 75 includes both documents.

sections.title: Reconcile the complete experiment
paragraphs: Meaning follows evaluation level, not a similar label.

code.output: Different levels produce 45 versus 75; the primary report variant is retained.

sections.title: Parameters fix computation
paragraphs: Supply virtual-table period, customer and status with correct types. A dynamic CurrentMonth parameter is convenient operationally but should be fixed for reproducible evidence. Avoid hidden conditions lost on reopening. A saved variant must restore every material value.

Source-period parameters constrain input before aggregation. Detail filters and group-total conditions act at different levels. The original report has a quick Customer filter; do not describe period/status quick fields as already implemented.

sections.title: Grouping does not change units
paragraphs: Customer minute sums remain minutes. For a per-document average, specify numerator and denominator; an average of group averages generally differs from the global average. Use customers with unequal request counts as a control. Apply rounding at the declared point.

In Designer open Reports → ЗаявкиПоКлиентам → Templates → ОсновнаяСхемаКомпоновкиДанных. Inspect Datasets, Resources and Settings. Retain the primary variant and create an own variant named by intent, such as Details above 30.

sections.title: Tests distinguish similar reports
paragraphs: Compare rows>30, groups>30, average and sum on one set. Specify expected identities and values beforehand, then save/reopen the variant. A missing-filter negative control must fail. If every variant accidentally yields one number, the dataset does not distinguish wrong implementations and must expand.

Reconcile all facts 75, details>30 → 45 and group total>30 → 75. Equal totals on another dataset do not prove equivalent rules. Add another own customer with 20/20: no detail exceeds 30, but its total 40 does.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A displayed number is accepted without its source. Reconcile actual references, units and raw values before presentation.
An unavailable feature is described as already tested. Record the exact edition and leave unperformed checks explicitly pending.
Hash identity is mistaken for safety or authorship. Separate byte integrity, reviewed trust and learner contribution.

selfcheck.prompt: Add 20/20 for another customer and prove the difference.

practice.title: Parameters, filters and grouping
practice.task: Add 20/20 for another customer and prove the difference.
practice.environment: Separate own synthetic infobase; retain the prior module and its backup. Studio and Sandbox optional.

steps.title: Preserve the starting state
steps.action: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.
steps.expected: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.
steps.troubleshooting: A new list name alone does not create another database directory.
steps.before: Own path, prior sources and a restorable backup identified.

steps.title: Add the complete server source
steps.action: Create a server/server-call module without Global or Privileged. Paste the complete source below outside other procedures; retain a single shared preparation function if already present.
steps.why: Database access has an explicit server boundary.
steps.expected: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not paste definitions inside startup or into an arbitrary Studio file.
steps.before: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.

steps.title: Prepare and call the experiment
steps.why: Print every named result instead of accepting compilation alone.
steps.expected: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.
steps.troubleshooting: Keep one startup handler; ensure the common module is server-call enabled.
steps.before: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.

steps.title: Save, update and run once
steps.action: Run once and reconcile the own document references with 2/75 then 1/45.
steps.why: Observe actual 1C data, not the browser diagram.
steps.expected: Different levels produce 45 versus 75; the primary report variant is retained.
steps.troubleshooting: Record the first failed assertion and module/line. Do not change the expectation merely to get True.
steps.before: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.

steps.title: Retain both results
steps.action: Remove only the startup caller, retain all source and use another copy for the negative case.
steps.why: Preserve provenance and avoid repeating data creation at every startup.
steps.expected: Original retained, negative experiment isolated, automatic caller removed.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not clear registers or delete old documents to make a total agree.
steps.before: Different levels produce 45 versus 75; the primary report variant is retained.
